11.2b — Create PT: Submit as Final

Today the Create PT becomes COLLEGE BOARD PROPERTY. You will open the Digital Portfolio, upload the program, the video, and the PPR, and press the button your teacher cannot press for you. Then — a unit's worth of weight off — we pivot to the exam itself.

Submission ~35 min

What goes in the Digital Portfolio (three things, in order):

  1. Program code (the .zip or the single file): your whole project — including the lines your PPR cites, verbatim
  2. Video: your sub-60s one take (11.2a)
  3. PPR: uploaded as your exam-day reference

That is the whole April submission. The four written responses are not part of it — you write those in Bluebook on May 14, with your PPR open. The drafts you wrote in 11.1e are your notes for that day, not a Portfolio upload.

The final final check — read aloud with a partner:

  • Every code excerpt in the PPR exists verbatim in the submitted program
  • Video plays from the Portfolio preview (not just your disk)
  • No names, no school, no faces without permission forms

Then Submit as Final. The deadline is April 30, 11:59 PM ET — you are submitting EARLY, because upload failures happen and the Portfolio does not care whose fault. Take the confirmation screenshot (yes, really) and put it in your repo: commit "11.2b: SUBMITTED".

Pivot ~15 min

The exam is next. Your Create PT is in — and it shares that 30% of your score with the four written-response prompts you will answer about it on exam day. The other 70% rests on the multiple-choice section alone. Both happen May 14, 8:00 AM, Session 1, in Bluebook: 70 multiple-choice questions (120 minutes), then 4 written responses (60 minutes) — WR1/WR2 on the END-OF-COURSE exam are the real thing, and your 11.1e drafts were rehearsal for exactly these; your PPR is open for all four. Everything from 9.1 to here is now MC practice material.

Checkpoint — before moving on, you must be able to:

  • See the Portfolio confirmation (screenshot in repo)
  • Verify the three uploaded artifacts match the final code, the final video, and the final PPR
  • State what is done: the Create PT is submitted — part of the 30% block, banked
  • State what remains: May 14, 8 AM, Bluebook — the 70% MCQ section, plus the 4 written responses that share that same 30% block
